brief:
Former U.S. President Donald Trump endorsed Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in a social media post ahead of legislative elections scheduled for October 27, calling him a "Strong, Brave, and Brilliant" leader, Al Jazeera English reported. The endorsement came as Israelis prepare to vote on their government's composition.

Netanyahu has faced domestic political pressure and legal challenges, including ongoing corruption trials. Trump and the Israeli premier have maintained a close relationship since Trump's presidency.
dek: In a social media post ahead of the October 27 election, Trump calls Netanyahu a 'Strong, Brave, and Brilliant' leader.
title: Trump endorses Netanyahu ahead of Israeli election
